_comment: Specimens excluded from the CALIPER validation only. Their measurements are sound — TXD_46 SL was verified independently as 3.12x a 50mm ruler span (156mm), TXD_42 as 3.13x (156.6mm) — but their spreadsheet sl(mm) rows do not correspond to the photographed fish. The mismatch is SCATTERED, not a block shift: TXD 4/6/7/8/9/43 agree to <=2.3% while 42/44/46/47/48/49/50 are off 5-32% with mixed sign, so no single numbering offset explains it. Filename numbering is authoritative per the lab. These specimens REMAIN valid for measurement and for model training.
